newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka tourist arrivals fall 25 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tourist arrivals fall 25 pct in 1996.

text.p: Tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka fell 25 percent to 302,265 in 1996 compared to the previous year, the Central Bank said in its annual report released on Wednesday.
As a result, earnings from the tourist industry declined to 9.1 billion rupees from 11.5 billion in the previous year, the report said.

But it added that the tourist sector, which suffered a major setback after a bomb attack on the Central Bank building in Colombo January last year, had started recovering slowly towards the end of 1996.
